svg.text: For users with huge follower counts, the feed is composed at read time from their latest posts instead of pre-pushed

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 1B users, 25% DAU = 250M; 10 feed loads/day each → 2.5B reads/day ≈ 25k reads/s × 200 KB ≈ 5 GB/s

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Writes: 10% of DAU upload one photo = 25M/day ≈ 250/s ≈ 50 MB/s; storage ≈ 5 TB/day ≈ 1.8 PB/year (the video's '60-100 TB/yr' figure is an arithmetic slip)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • NFRs: high availability, geographically distributed users, feed < 1 s, near-zero data loss. Subscribe API writes follower rows to SQL
